lint_exemption.approver: user (product owner) -- explicit approval in session
lint_exemption.justification: WP-01 and WP-02 were each reviewed across MANY rounds: 6 brief rounds and 11 implementation-signature rounds for WP-01, 3 brief and 11 consult rounds for WP-02. Every round's decision was committed as it happened so the audit trail stayed readable, which produced 39 status-only commits. Contract 4.3 asks for exactly two (freeze + finalize); the substance it protects -- that a WP's status is frozen once and finalised once, with no half-signed state committed as if final -- is satisfied: each WP has exactly ONE freeze commit (the add) and exactly ONE finalize commit recording state=MERGED with both signatures folded in. Squashing the 39 review-round commits would rewrite the integration branch and discard the per-round history that documents how two fatal spec defects were caught. The user chose this documented exemption over that rewrite.
